evidence.title: Bundesliga season 2026-27: All you need to know

occurrences.checkable_against: DFB Bundesliga 2026-27 competition and refereeing regulations
occurrences.quote_span: Measures are being introduced to improve time management, with the referees able to use the five-second countdown that was on show at the World Cup for goal kicks and throw ins.

occurrences.subject: 2026-27 Bundesliga season

occurrences.quote_span: The November international break will remain a nine-day interruption.

occurrences.checkable_against: official Bundesliga 2026-27 calendar and FIFA international match calendar
occurrences.quote_span: There will also be a new longer international break this season, which sees September's and October's breaks merge into one three-week break starting on September 24 and ending on October 4.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026-27 Bundesliga season

occurrences.quote_span: If a player covers his mouth during a dispute with an opponent, he may be punished with a yellow card.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026-27 Bundesliga season

occurrences.quote_span: The first 'Klassiker' of the new Bundesliga season is at the end of October and will be played in Munich.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026-27 Bundesliga season

occurrences.quote_span: Substitutes will have 10 seconds to leave the pitch, otherwise the new player will have to wait until a break in play – at least a minute later – before he can return to the field.
